overall: Board did not violate the OML. The minutes request was sent only to the Town Clerk, did not cite the OML, and did not ask for forwarding to the Board, so it was not an OML request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to provide requested open and executive session minutes within 10 days as the Open Meeting Law requires.
allegations.key_passage: Under the circumstances present here, we find that the request for meeting minutes was not a request that fell under the Open Meeting Law.
